[[File:Hailfire_droid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank]]]]
The term '''droid tank''' or '''tank droid''' referred to any type of [[Tank/Legends|tank]] that operated without the assistance of a [[Species/Legends|live]] crew. Much like [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], they were operated through the use of a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]]; these could either be independently-controlled or governed by remote interface with a tactical [[Computer/Legends|computer]]; in this way they were much like ordinary [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] counterparts. Tank [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were utilized throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|the history]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], from the [[Old Sith Wars]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[XR-85 tank droid]], just one of the types of tank droids, was created during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The XR-85 tank prototype was built before [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The original prototype was too expensive to be mass produced. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later, Imperial [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] refined the XR-85 and a contract was signed for this model to be mass produced. The XR-85 was first designed to deal with civil unrest in Imperial [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but they proved to be some of the Empires most powerful machinery so they were sent to the [[Ground warfare/Legends|front lines]]. The XR-85 was driven by a droid brain, which made it even more impressive than it already was. The vehicle was on tracks. It was approximately 32 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and over 30 meters tall. It was double the size of an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. Its top speed was 70 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], but was nearly unstoppable. Its main weapon was a frontal heavy particle [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]]. Its range was 5 kilometers, and had the power to level bunkers with one shot. There were also two turbo-[[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] also firing to the front. Also there were 4 heavy [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], 2 facing front, 2 back. The XR-85 was the most successful droid controlled tank of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Civil War. Its pirated [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] [[R7 droid brain matrix|R7 droid brain]] was top of the line. It even had intuition programming. Though there was no substitute for a living [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], it was far better than other similar machines.
